title: Comfy!
text: Comfy!. After I ordered this, I was skimming through some of the reviews. I began to worry. There were several unfavorable comments. So my expectations were quite low. It arrived and I didn't open it for days because I knew I was going to be disappointed. Well.....I wasn't. I absolutely love it. I'm a size 18/20 plus size mom. I have thicker arms which can be problematic at times when it comes to fit. This fits me perfectly. Another thing I was worried about was the thickness. I thought it would be thick like other plush robes. The description says you could wear it out and about. I envisioned the thick robe and said to myself, there's no way I would wear it in public. It's not that thick and I can totally see myself wearing it. It's not like a traditional robe at all. It's more of a loose cardigan/cape with sleeves. It's very comfy. I plan to wear this a lot this winter!

product_metadata.title: UnHide Shleepy Faux Fur Robe - Lightweight, Extra Soft, & Warm Wearable Blanket - Made From Soft Polyester Faux Fur Material - Machine Washable - Beige Bear - Plus Size
features: THE SHLEEPY: Introducing the perfect robe for when you’re cozying up on the couch or out and about. The Shleepy makes you feel like you’re cocooned in your favorite blanket. It adds a perfect layer of comfort and warmth.

NO FUR, ALL CHILL: Our blanket robe is made from the same chinchilla-soft faux fur polyester material as our popular Marshmallow blankets. Each Shleepy is butter soft and will keep you cozy at all times!
COMFORT AT ITS FINEST: Wear it everyday, everywhere. The Shleepy is like a wearable, comfy blanket made with roomy pockets to sink your hands into and has a soft hood to keep your head cozy and warm.

TOO SOFT TO LEAVE BEHIND: The Shleepy can be the perfect travel and airport companion or it can help keep you comfortable in your cold work office. This soft loungewear is lightweight and can easily be folded up if you need to pack it with you.

BETTER THAN THE REAL THING: We want to create a world where no animal is harmed in the name of fashion or comfort. Our products are cruelty-free and eco-friendly, they are the comfiest and safest faux fur blankets and wearables you can find!
